maddeler.e:
اقتفيا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَفَيَا (iqtafayā) /iq.ta.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اُقْتُفِيَا (uqtufiyā) /uq.tu.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اِقْتَفِيَا (iqtafiyā) /iq.ta.fi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
